message.content: How do I clean up the history of my feature branch before merging?

content.text: Use an interactive rebase: `git rebase -i origin/main`, then mark the commits you want to combine as `squash` or `fixup`. Warning: this rewrites history, so afterwards the branch can only be pushed with a force push, which replaces the remote branch. Anyone who already pulled the branch would have to reset their copy. Only do this on a branch nobody else is working on.

message.content: OK, I squashed my 5 commits into one.

content.text: Good. Check the result with `git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD`; you should see a single commit with a clean message.
